headlines.snippet: Sgt. Ron Jonathan Reitman and Sgt. Yuval Shi Sulem fell in a terrorist attack at the Etzion Junction. Reitman, 23, was from Ashkelon, and Sulem, 20, was from Hod HaSharon. They served in the Erez Battalion of the Refitting Brigade. Three other soldiers were wounded. The terrorists were killed, and suspicions of a foreign photographer's prior knowledge of the attack are being investigated. Netanyahu ordered an immediate cordon of Hebron and a full closure of the West Bank.
